Hi Amit —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from my side so we stay aligned: 

1) Scope recap: You confirmed priority use-case is low-latency embedding/semantic search for customer support docs (~10k monthly active queries; peak burst concurrency ~50 req/s).
2) Primary constraints: data residency in us-east, strict PII redaction, and procurement needs vendor W-9 + ACH setup.
3) Next steps (for your procurement team):
   - FinServe ops to initiate vendor portal invite so our finance team can upload W-9 and contract (Target: this week)
   - I'll share Redwood W-9 and onboarding instructions (attached)
   - Once vendor is created and ACH details are confirmed, we can schedule a 30-min enablement/kickoff to scope integration.

I’ve attached: Redwood_W9.pdf and Vendor_Onboarding_Instructions.pdf for your records.

Would you mind confirming who on your side will own the portal invite (name/email) and an expected ETA? If easier, I can loop in our finance ops contact to coordinate directly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Best,
